SELECT ANY_VALUE(g.id) AS id, ANY_VALUE(g.group_hash) AS group_hash, ANY_VALUE(g.group_name) AS group_name, ANY_VALUE(g.group_type) AS group_type, ANY_VALUE(g.reply_type) AS reply_type, ANY_VALUE(COALESCE(g.status, 1)) AS status, ANY_VALUE(g.source) AS source, ANY_VALUE(g.source_page) AS source_page, ANY_VALUE(g.visitor_name) AS visitor_name, ANY_VALUE(g.visitor_contact) AS visitor_contact, ANY_VALUE(g.visitor_company) AS visitor_company, ANY_VALUE(g.visitor_demand) AS visitor_demand, ANY_VALUE(g.first_response_at) AS first_response_at, ANY_VALUE(g.last_msg_at) AS last_msg_at, ANY_VALUE(g.closed_at) AS closed_at, ANY_VALUE(g.assignee_user_hash) AS assignee_user_hash, ANY_VALUE(g.tags) AS tags, ANY_VALUE(g.summary) AS summary, ANY_VALUE(COALESCE(g.lead_status, 0)) AS lead_status, ANY_VALUE(g.lead_id) AS lead_id, ANY_VALUE(g.create_time) AS create_time, ANY_VALUE(g.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msg.id) AS un_read_num FROM cc_group g LEFT JOIN cc_group_user_rel current_gur ON current_gur.group_hash = g.group_hash AND current_gur.user_hash = #{pageDTO.userHash} LEFT JOIN cc_session_msg latest_msg ON latest_msg.group_hash = g.group_hash LEFT JOIN cc_session_msg msg ON msg.group_hash = g.group_hash AND msg.user_type = 0 AND msg.create_time > COALESCE(current_gur.last_visit_time, '1970-01-01') WHERE ( current_gur.user_hash IS NOT NULL OR g.assignee_user_hash IS NULL OR g.assignee_user_hash = '' OR g.assignee_user_hash = #{pageDTO.userHash} ) AND g.group_hash IS NOT NULL
AND (g.status = #{pageDTO.status} OR g.status IS NULL)
AND g.status = #{pageDTO.status}
GROUP BY g.group_hash ORDER BY GREATEST( COALESCE(ANY_VALUE(g.last_msg_at), '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(MAX(latest_msg.create_time), '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(ANY_VALUE(g.create_time), '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(MAX(current_gur.create_time), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') ) DESC, ANY_VALUE(g.create_time) DESC, un_read_num DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cc_group SET visitor_contact = #{phone}, visitor_demand = CASE #{intent} WHEN 'book_demo' THEN '预约演示' WHEN 'pricing' THEN '价格与版本' WHEN 'private_deployment' THEN '私有化/源码' ELSE visitor_demand END, source_page = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sourcePage}, ''), source_page), lead_status = COALESCE(lead_status, 0) WHERE group_hash = #{groupHash}
UPDATE cc_group SET status = #{status}, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 3 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE group_hash = #{groupHash} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
